# MailTemps

> MailTemps is a free, receive-only temporary email service. An inbox starts at 10 minutes, can be extended twice by 10 minutes, and can be deleted manually. No registration is required.

## Product facts and limits

- The service receives email but does not send or reply.
- Inbox access uses a secret token; the server stores its hash.
- The interface displays plain text and does not render remote email HTML, images, scripts, or tracking pixels.
- Temporary email is not guaranteed anonymous or end-to-end encrypted.
- Do not use it for banking, sensitive data, important accounts, or long-term recovery.
- The product API supports the MailTemps frontend and is not currently offered as a documented public developer API.
